name: UK 20th Anniversary 2026

venue.name: The Edge, Leeds
venue.address: The Edge University of Leeds Leeds, LS2 9JT

information: #### Celebrating 20 years since the first WCA competition in the UK! ##### On November 18th, 2006, the UK hosted its first ever WCA competition, and since then we have gone on to hold over 350 more across the country. For this very special anniversary we're returning to where it all started, to celebrate the UK cubing scene, and another 20 years of success! T-Shirts for this competition will be available to buy separately on the UKCA website closer to the competition. Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)
